voiceSummary: Sun Pharma Advanced Research Company Limited submitted a clarification regarding an increase in volume for its scrip symbol SPARC. The company confirmed compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. It stated that all required disclosures under this regulation have been made to the exchanges. The company asserted it is not aware of any undisclosed information qualifying for disclosure. The communication was addressed to the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. and signed by Kajal Damania, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, on November 11, 2026.
